problem:
Calculate the number of terms in the following arithmetic series.

$$
1+3+5+…=81
$$
worked_solution:
To solve this problem, we use the formula for the sum of an arithmetic series:

$$
{S}_{N}=\frac{N}{2}(2{a}_{1}+(N-1)d)\,\,
$$

We have been given the sum ${S}_{N}=81$, and the first term ${a}_{1}=1.$ Our goal is to find $N,$ the number of terms.

The common difference $d$ can be found, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={a}_{2}-{a}_{1} \\  & =3-1 \\  & =2\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting these values into the formula for the sum of an arithmetic series, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{N} & =\frac{N}{2}(2{a}_{1}+(N-1)d) \\ 81 & =\frac{N}{2}(2\cdot 1+(N-1)\cdot 2) \\ 81 & =\frac{N}{2}(2+2N-2) \\ 81 & =\frac{N}{2}(2N) \\ 81 & ={N}^{2} \\ N & =9\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that we take the positive square root because $N$can't be negative. Therefore, our series has $N=9$ terms.
